method: Scan every multi-task turn from both frozen studies. Prefer structured answer-from roots; otherwise use successfully observed current result reads as candidates. Form upstream closure from the saved task-end workflow. No model judgment or new solver call.
limits: Result-read candidates can include verification or exploratory reads that did not support the answer; they are not semantic answer attribution.
Historical reads are reported separately because their closure must bind the historical snapshot, not task-end current state.
A root missing at task end must use its actual read-time snapshot, not a substituted live definition.

inspect task returns a touched/selected-operator index rather than an answer-root sub-DAG.
inspect state returns selected operators and immediate input definitions, with saved implementations/results on request.
fork operator from task recursively clones the historical upstream closure; safe version-bound traversal already exists for mutation but not as one task read.
All successful execution outcomes, including cached results and unrelated completed branches in whole-graph execution, contribute observed accesses; these do not equal minimal question dependencies.
gaps: Only 10/520 answers have explicit composed-answer table roots in these traces. Other result reads give candidates, not certified answer attribution.
A task may need multiple output roots or historical versions. A task-level ancestor link must not silently replace an explicitly requested comparison baseline.
A saved snapshot can be wrong; correcting a downstream summary alone leaves shared upstream errors in place.

recommendation.context: Original prior-task request including its context/constraints, bounded unverified answer, task ID and parent task IDs. Detailed operator/version receipts remain retrievable.
recommendation.retrieval: Extend the existing task inspection with a bounded answer-sub-DAG view: saved snapshot identifier, output roots, their full upstream node/edge manifest, schemas and result availability; implementation and samples/stats requested within budgets. Every node is from the addressed snapshot; read-only, no execution. Clearly identify explicit versus candidate roots and missing/truncated evidence.
recommendation.mutation: Use existing version-bound fork/update and targeted execution; keep historical baselines addressable and recompute outputs after correcting upstream definitions.
recommendation.prompt_example: Past tasks form an index of requests, unverified answers, and observed dependencies. Retrieve a relevant task’s saved dataflow and upstream definitions when you need its computations. Check that its rules, input scope, and version match the current request. Modify or fork the branch as needed; after correcting an upstream step, recompute affected outputs before relying on them. Retrieve separate saved versions when a comparison needs multiple baselines.
recommendation.evaluation: Future matched ablation should separate lighter index from batched task-sub-DAG retrieval; retain total/correct-answer spending, cache reuse, discovery calls, official accuracy and manually established cascades. Benchmark annotation IDs stay out of normal solver prompts. No performance improvement claimed from this offline review.
